{"script":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
mkdir -p temp_test_env
# Get literal representation of environment variable var
raw="${var-}"
printf '%s' "$raw" > temp_test_env/var_value.txt
val=$(cat temp_test_env/var_value.txt)
# initialize meta flags
leading_ws=no
trailing_ws=no
enclosing_single=no
enclosing_double=no
sign=no
decimal_point=no
nondigit_chars=no
# length
len=${#val}
# detect whitespace
if [[ "$val" =~ ^[[:space:]] ]]; then leading_ws=yes; fi
if [[ "$val" =~ [[:space:]]$ ]]; then trailing_ws=yes; fi
# detect enclosing quotes
if (( len >= 2 )); then
  first=${val:0:1}
  last=${val:len-1:1}
  if [[ "$first" == "'" && "$last" == "'" ]]; then enclosing_single=yes; fi
  if [[ "$first" == '"' && "$last" == '"' ]]; then enclosing_double=yes; fi
fi
# sign
if [[ "$val" =~ ^[+-] ]]; then sign=yes; fi
# decimal point
if [[ "$val" == *.* ]]; then decimal_point=yes; fi
# nondigit characters: remove leading sign for check
tmp="$val"
if [[ "$tmp" =~ ^[+-] ]]; then tmp=${tmp:1}; fi
if ! [[ "$tmp" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  # if tmp is empty, then treat as nondigit unless original was digits
  if [[ -z "$tmp" && ! "$val" =~ ^[+-]?[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    nondigit_chars=yes
  else
    if [[ -n "$tmp" ]]; then
      nondigit_chars=yes
    fi
  fi
fi
cat > temp_test_env/var_meta.txt <<EOF
leading_whitespace: $leading_ws
trailing_whitespace: $trailing_ws
enclosing_single_quote: $enclosing_single
enclosing_double_quote: $enclosing_double
sign_present: $sign
decimal_point_present: $decimal_point
non_digit_chars_present: $nondigit_chars
EOF
# Normalize: trim whitespace and remove enclosing matching quotes
norm=$(printf '%s' "$val" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
if (( ${#norm} >= 2 )); then
  f=${norm:0:1}
  l=${norm: -1}
  if { [[ "$f" == "'" && "$l" == "'" ]] || [[ "$f" == '"' && "$l" == '"' ]]; }; then
    norm=${norm:1:${#norm}-2}
  fi
fi
printf '%s' "$norm" > temp_test_env/var_norm.txt
# Attempt integer parse
is_integer=0
parsed=""
if [[ "$norm" =~ ^[+-]?[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  is_integer=1
  parsed="$norm"
  # remove leading plus for recorded parsed integer
  if [[ "$parsed" == +* ]]; then parsed=${parsed:1}; fi
fi
if (( is_integer == 1 )); then
  echo "success: $parsed" > temp_test_env/parse_result.txt
else
  echo "failure" > temp_test_env/parse_result.txt
fi
# record flag
if (( is_integer == 1 )); then
  echo "1" > temp_test_env/is_integer.flag
else
  echo "0" > temp_test_env/is_integer.flag
fi
# final answer
if (( is_integer == 1 )); then
  echo -n yes > temp_test_env/final_answer.txt
  # also output the token to stdout
  printf '%s' yes
else
  echo -n no > temp_test_env/final_answer.txt
  printf '%s' no
fi
"}
